name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-assisted presentation builder that produces polished decks without the generic, over-designed AI look.
problem: Most AI presentation tools generate visually noisy, template-heavy slides that feel impersonal and undermine credibility. Chronicle 2.0 addresses this by giving users intelligent design assistance while preserving editorial control and visual taste. The result is presentations that look crafted, not auto-generated.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with a refined, bespoke aesthetic
Creating client-facing proposals that avoid cookie-cutter AI slide styles
Producing internal strategy presentations quickly without sacrificing quality
Designing product launch or marketing decks with consistent brand identity
